pages.title: Basic Pipe
pages.text: Bamboo pipes connect to nearby pipes, tea work blocks, containers, and ports. The basic rate is 1 item every 5 ticks.

Pipe color is the channel. Right-click a pipe with dye to recolor it. Pipes of the same color connect into one network; different colors stay separate even when adjacent.$(br2)By default, pipes extract only from this mod's work blocks. Normal containers are input targets unless an output port is used.

pages.title: Output Port
pages.text: An output port marks an active extraction point. Place it beside a container or work block; it extracts from the block it faces.

If a pipe network contains an output port that can extract an item, output ports take priority over default work-block output. The network extracts from ports first, and falls back to work blocks when ports have nothing available.$(br2)Items from work blocks are not sent into blocks that have output ports, preventing fresh output from cycling back into an extraction container.

pages.title: Input Port
pages.text: An input port only accepts input. Place it beside a container or work block; pipes can insert into the block it faces, but they will not extract from that port.

Input ports have the lowest target priority. The network tries normal containers or work-block targets first, and only tries input ports when those targets cannot accept the item.$(br2)If multiple input ports are available, the pipe rotates between them. Right-click an input port to open its filter screen and choose whitelist or blacklist mode.

pages.title: Redstone Port
pages.text: A redstone port lets redstone control a pipe connection. When closed, items cannot pass through that connection; when open, it behaves like a controlled pipe segment.

pages.title: Bamboo Wrench
pages.text: Right-click a pipe side with the bamboo wrench to toggle that side's connection. Sneak-right-click a pipe, input or output port to quickly break it.$(br2)The wrench rotates horizontal-facing blocks such as tea tables and roasting pans. Ports auto-align to adjacent containers or pipes and cannot be rotated manually, and redstone ports cannot be wrench-broken.

pages.title: Output Rules
pages.text: Source priority: output ports are highest, followed by this mod's work-block default outputs. Normal containers are not extracted by plain pipes unless you add an output port.$(br2)Target priority: normal insertable blocks first, input ports last. Multiple sources, normal targets, and input ports are all scheduled by rotation.
